Both files rewritten.

**`parser.mjs`** — `parseOrders(text)`:
- Throws `TypeError` for non-string input.
- Splits on `\n`; CRLF is handled because each field is trimmed (trailing `\r` removed). Blank/whitespace-only rows skipped.
- Requires exactly 3 comma-separated fields; trims each field.
- Validates SKU against `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*$`.
- Quantity/price must be pure base-10 digits (`/^[0-9]+$/`, so no signs, decimals, exponents, or empty strings); quantity must be > 0, price may be 0.
- Values above `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` throw `RangeError`; other malformed rows throw `Error`.
- Returns a fresh array of `{ sku, quantity, unitPriceCents }` in input order, duplicates preserved.

**`report.mjs`** — `buildReport(text)`:
- Calls `parseOrders`, aggregates per SKU in a `Map`, and returns `{ items, totalUnits, totalCents }`.
- `items` is a new array sorted lexicographically by SKU, each `{ sku, quantity, totalCents }` with `totalCents` = Σ quantity × unitPriceCents.
- `totalUnits` sums all quantities; `totalCents` sums all line totals.
- `RangeError` if any line total, per-SKU subtotal, or running aggregate exceeds `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.
- No module-level mutable state; input is not modified. Empty input yields `{ items: [], totalUnits: 0, totalCents: 0 }`.

No tests were run — only the two files were read and rewritten; no execution environment was available.
